chain: Owner: on the host, verify-security's job-network check crashed ("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'includes')"). Its probe script puts one line per host address:port pair (about 1,200) into one `bash -c` argument, over the 128 KB per-argument limit, so spawnSync fails with E2BIG and no stdout. claim:
PR title: fix(security): verify-security reports a job probe that can't start instead of crashing

Why: on the live host the job-network check crashed (`Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'includes')`). Its probe script put one `tcp` line per host address:port pair (1197 pairs) into one `bash -c` argument: 150 KB, over the 128 KB per-argument limit, so spawnSync returned E2BIG with no stdout. Not an isolation problem: bwrap, its AppArmor profile and pasta are fine, and a small jailed command runs.

- Targets go through one `printf | xargs -P 32` line instead of a line each.
- A spawn error is now reported as "the jailed probe could not start: <error> (<command>)".
- lean `trusted` +1.

Checked on the host (probe run from ~/aidenhq without editing it): `1197 host address:port pairs refused`, exit 0, ~3s. The xargs line reports an open port (127.0.0.1:22) when unjailed.
